subject.title: Disable Chrome OptGuide/WasmTts model downloads in headless/server mode

question: Should OpenClaw add OptimizationGuide/WasmTts disabled-feature flags by default for managed and sandbox headless Chrome launches, or keep this as an operator-controlled `browser.extraArgs`/custom-entrypoint workaround?
rationale: The code change is small, but the upstream Chrome flag behavior is version-sensitive and the current shipped workaround already covers local managed profiles; default launch behavior needs maintainer intent after live proof.

options.title: Prove, then add headless defaults
options.body: Run live current-Chrome proof, then add the selected disabled-feature list to managed and sandbox headless launches with focused launch-arg tests and docs.

options.title: Document operator control only
options.body: Keep defaults unchanged and document `browser.extraArgs` for local managed profiles plus custom sandbox entrypoints as the supported server-mode mitigation.

options.title: Add an explicit config knob
options.body: Introduce a dedicated browser model-download suppression option only if maintainers decide the existing config surface is insufficient despite the repo's high bar for new config.

recommendation.title: Prove, then add headless defaults
recommendation.body: Run live current-Chrome proof, then add the selected disabled-feature list to managed and sandbox headless launches with focused launch-arg tests and docs.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on the managed browser surface, the browser-plugin ownership move, and the prior related PR review.
